blocks.text:
The programme deliberately leaves time between the scheduled tours. On the morning of 31 December, you will visit Corcovado, with time to rest in the afternoon before heading to Copacabana in the evening. On 1 January, you will explore Sugarloaf Mountain and historic Rio. Spend your free day on the beach, at the Botanical Garden, on the islands of Angra dos Reis, visiting the favelas or flying over the city.

## Additional expenses

- A New Year's Eve dinner or hotel party can be booked separately.
- Tropical islands of Angra dos Reis: USD 100 per person.
- Botanical Garden: USD 150 per person, minimum 2 people.
- Favela tour: USD 60 per person in a group with an English-speaking guide, or USD 120 per person for a private tour, minimum 2 people.
- Hang gliding: USD 350 per person.
- A helicopter flight can be booked separately.
